purpose: Deeper public Contact Research for BTX Omni Prospect using official public company sources plus publicly indexed professional-profile information. This is research evidence, not BTX CRM truth.

methodology.named_contact_rule: Include a named person only when a public search result or official source clearly connects the person to the company and a relevant function.
methodology.reverification_rule: PUBLIC_PROFILE_VERIFIED contacts must be re-verified before outreach because public professional roles can change.

truth_rules.named_public_contact: Public professional contact verified on an official source. Not a BTX CRM contact.
truth_rules.public_contact_channel: Official supplier/procurement/partnership/contact channel. Not a named buyer.
truth_rules.role_target: Desired role family for research when no named public contact is verified.
truth_rules.hubspot_boundary: Later HubSpot contacts remain a separate BTX-internal truth source and may be matched to, but must not be conflated with, public research contacts.
